subject: business
title: Planning a Business and Raising Finance

questions.question: A business can buy a machine for $40,000 or lease it for $900 a month over 48 months. Calculate the additional cost of leasing rather than buying. (4 marks)
Explain one advantage and one disadvantage for a technology start-up of using venture capital as a source of finance. (4 marks)
A founder who owns all 120,000 shares in her company raises $60,000 by issuing 30,000 new shares to a business angel. Analyse the impact of this decision on the founder. (6 marks)
A profitable partnership running three restaurants plans to open ten more and needs finance it cannot generate itself. Assess whether it should incorporate as a private limited company. (10 marks)
Evaluate the view that a detailed business plan is the most important factor in determining whether a new business succeeds. (20 marks)

leaves.wording: Relevance and uses of a business plan.
